```artifact
Feature: Prescription Generation and Mapping
  As a patient,
  I want to generate a prescription through a Patient Consultation Request
    Background:
      Given a valid Patient Consultation Request

Scenario: Generate a single prescription from a valid Patient Consultation Request
  When I submit a valid Patient Consultation Request
  Then I should generate exactly one prescription

Scenario: Generate multiple prescriptions from multiple valid Patient Consultation Requests
  Given multiple valid Patient Consultation Requests
  When I submit them
  Then I should generate multiple prescriptions

Scenario: Ensure each prescription is mapped to one and only one Patient Consultation Request
  Given a valid Patient Consultation Request
  When I process the prescription
  Then the prescription should be linked to exactly one Patient Consultation Request

Scenario: Chemists receive one or more prescriptions with only required fields
  Given a valid Patient Consultation Request
  And the required fields for a prescription are present
  When I submit the prescription
  Then the chemist should receive it with only the required fields

Scenario: Each prescription is mapped to one and only one Chemist
  Given a valid Patient Consultation Request
  And the required fields for a prescription are present
  When I submit the prescription
  Then the chemist assigned should be linked to exactly one Chemist

Scenario: Labs receive one or more prescriptions with only required fields
  Given a valid Patient Consultation Request
  And the required fields for a prescription are present
  When I submit the prescription
  Then the lab assigned should be linked to exactly one Lab

Scenario: Each prescription is mapped to one and only one Lab
  Given a valid Patient Consultation Request
  And the required fields for a prescription are present
  When I submit the prescription
  Then the lab assigned should be linked to exactly one Lab

Scenario: Prescription not linked to any Patient Consultation Request
  Given an invalid Patient Consultation Request
  And the required fields for a prescription are present
  When I submit the prescription
  Then the system should indicate an error due to invalid request

Scenario: Chemist receives no prescriptions
  Given no valid Patient Consultation Requests
  And the required fields for a prescription are present
  When I attempt to submit a prescription
  Then the system should indicate an error due to lack of patient data

Scenario: Lab receives no prescriptions
  Given no valid Patient Consultation Requests
  And the required fields for a prescription are present
  When I attempt to submit a prescription
  Then the system should indicate an error due to lack of patient data

Scenario: Prescription linked to multiple Chemists
  Given a valid Patient Consultation Request
  And the required fields for a prescription are present
  And multiple Chemists are available
  When I submit the prescription
  Then the system should link the prescription to only one Chemist

Scenario: Prescription linked to multiple Labs
  Given a valid Patient Consultation Request
  And the required fields for a prescription are present
  And multiple Labs are available
  When I submit the prescription
  Then the system should link the prescription to only one Lab

Scenario: Prescription not linked to any Lab
  Given an invalid Patient Consultation Request
  And the required fields for a prescription are present
  When I submit the prescription
  Then the system should indicate an error due to invalid request
```
